input: Supplied non-spatial proposal; sourceIdentities identify the actual code exercised. The referenceBaseline label does not identify a newer checkout.
scope: Actual unchanged production reducer and Session; mechanical proposal only. No production edits, spatial geometry, model clearance, animation, UI/browser, phone or fun claim.

witnesses.description: Carry six spaces through deep water and deliver the whole first group via Outer Buoy. Board the low pair exactly on the second rise.
After carrying six spaces, leave both sheep safely at High Quay. Rescue the low pair early, carry four rabbits through the depth-three shortcut, then collect the sheep.

A supported safe variation, not the second main critical strategy: stage one sheep, rescue the low pair, then wait only after all endangered piers are empty. Five bodies occupy six spaces; return at the second rise and collect the staged sheep later.
Two optional entry pauses remain recoverable by choosing the staging plan; the full deep-delivery plan has less deadline slack.

losingAlternatives.description: One extra pause before committing to the full deep-delivery route leaves the low pair waiting when action 10 arrives.
Saving the low pair first reaches Wide Berth at action 5, after the rise has flooded its waiting first group; arrival is not boarding.
Taking a four-space subset and leaving a sheep at Wide Berth cannot get back to board that sheep before the first rise.
Waiting with the full first group at High Quay until the shortcut reaches depth four floods Shell Landing with its pair still waiting.
Staging the first group safely does not remove the low pair deadline.

boundedSearch.turnNormalization: Clamp only state-key turn at action 10; reducer retains real turns.
boundedSearch.passengerOrderNormalization: Ignore array order only in reachability keys; identity and membership remain exact.
boundedSearch.traceProperty: Keep a carriedSix flag in each search key to verify that every surviving first-rise path has already used the larger capacity.
boundedSearch.legalActionCoverage: Wait, every adjacent legal move, all nonempty board and unload subsets.
boundedSearch.claim: Feasibility and bounded mechanical reachability only; not a product difficulty or playtime claim.
